provenance: Independent source audit followed by direct reading and comparison of the immutable packet inputs on 2026-11-01. Shared unit, selection and policy snapshots were read once per identical input across this 25-unit review set. No earlier favorable decision was used as evidence for the conclusion.
rationale: The dependency chain through unit:given.storage_places supplies p, q, x, α/β, S and slot lookup. This unit defines resolution before it is used by evaluation. Resolve.variable requires a (name,some object) variable entry. Resolve.field requires resolution of the base, the corresponding parent object entry and a (field,some object) field entry. These are exactly the Variable and Field rules once Stored is expanded; the intermediate source q is deliberately discarded when the final storage place becomes β.f. Neither constructor updates the fixed state. Absent entries and none cannot satisfy the premises, matching failure on every unoccupied segment.
limitations: This is a correspondence comparison of the frozen prose, exact selected statements/definitions, and identified semantic context. No Lean build, test execution, or proof-tactic audit was performed; compilation and evidence validation are separate checks.

Listed full-source context snapshots were consulted for the supporting declarations and example states discussed in the rationale and dependency comparisons; the listing does not claim examination of every unrelated proof or declaration in those files.
